_comment: The PRINT layer: everything the frame stage draws that GMNotes must not carry (SCED rule: printed text lives on art). Rules text transcribed from cards_v0.2 (errata-grade) and encounter_v0.4 §5/§5b; [wil]-style markup renders via cardforge/glyphs.py or the SE plugin's tags. Enemy combat stats exist only here. FLAG: The House Always Wins had no statline anywhere in the design docs — the one here is a DRAFT (owner to confirm).

sthr-elias.text:
[reaction] When another investigator at your location would take 1 or more damage that is not direct damage: Elias takes that damage instead, then place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[reaction] If you are the only investigator at your location, after Elias takes 1 or more damage from an enemy: place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[elder] +1. If there are 3 or more Memory on Elias, this token is +3 instead, and heal 1 damage from Elias.
sthr-elias.flavor: "I have died in this night more times than anyone. I'll stand between you and the dark once more."
sthr-elias.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Survivor cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Ambergrove Lamp, "I've Done This Before", The Eighth Grave.
sthr-elias.back_flavor: Lighthouse keeper of Ambergrove. He has died in this night more times than anyone, and he keeps standing between the town and the dark.

sthr-lamp.text:
While the Ambergrove Lamp is in play, each investigator at your location gets +1 [agi] while evading.
[action], exhaust, raise Dissonance by 1: Look at the top card of the encounter deck of a location connected to you. You may then move to that location.
sthr-lamp.flavor: A lamp that remembers the safe path.

sthr-donebefore.text: Commit only to a skill test. If you have already failed a skill test of the same type ([wil]/[int]/[com]/[agi]) this scenario, this card provides [wild][wild][wild]; otherwise it provides [wild].

sthr-eighthgrave.text: Revelation — Take 1 horror for each Memory on Elias (maximum 4). If there is no Memory on Elias, instead search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Echo and spawn it engaged with you.
sthr-eighthgrave.flavor: You remember every time you did not come back.

sthr-ayako.text:
After you succeed at an [int] skill test: place 1 Memory on Ayako. Limit once per turn.
During each interlude, you may move any amount of Memory from Ayako to your banked Memory.
[elder] +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 less to play this turn.
sthr-ayako.flavor: "The night is speaking a dead language. I intend to read it."
sthr-ayako.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Mystic cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Lexicon of the Hour, "It Means 'Wait'", Untranslatable.
sthr-ayako.back_flavor: A linguist who came to Ambergrove chasing a dead language — and found it being spoken by the night itself.

sthr-lexicon.text:
After you succeed at an [int] test by 2 or more: place 1 secret on the Lexicon (max 5).
[free] Exhaust, spend 1 secret: choose one — get +2 to an [int] test you are performing; or cancel the "when revealed" effect of a non-Elite Static treachery.

sthr-itmeanswait.text: Fast. Play when you would be affected by a card in the Occultation or The Appointed encounter set. If you have 3 or more banked Memory, cancel that effect.
sthr-itmeanswait.flavor: Some of it is just a request to hold on.

sthr-untranslatable.text: Revelation — Take horror equal to half your banked Memory, rounded up (maximum 5).

sthr-cass.text:
[free] Once per turn, spend 2 resources to call the tide: predict a chaos token symbol. The next time you reveal the predicted symbol during a skill test you perform this round, cancel that token and place 1 Memory on Cass.
[elder] +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass (maximum +3 resources).
sthr-cass.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 cards of any other class at level 0, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Marked Deck, "Seen This Hand Before", The House Always Wins.
sthr-cass.back_flavor: A gambler who figured out the night resets three drinks before anyone else. She has been running the same hours for profit.

sthr-markeddeck.text:
[free] Exhaust: Look at the next chaos token you would reveal this round.
[free] Exhaust, raise Dissonance by 1, remove 1 Memory from a card you control: Seal a non-symbol chaos token from the bag until the end of the round.
sthr-markeddeck.flavor: You already know how this hand plays.

sthr-seenthishand.text: Fast. Play when a chaos token is revealed during your skill test: cancel that token and gain 2 resources. If the cancelled token was a symbol token, gain 3 resources instead.

sthr-housewins.text:
Hunter.
Spawns at the location with the most clues (you choose if tied). While Cass has more Memory on her cards than any other investigator, The House Always Wins cannot be evaded.
Forced — When The House Always Wins defeats an investigator: that investigator's controller loses 3 banked Memory.
sthr-housewins.flavor: The debt follows you across every loop.
sthr-housewins._stats_note: DRAFT statline — no source in the design docs; owner to confirm.

sthr-seraphine.text:
During your turn, you may raise Dissonance by 1 to choose one: this investigator gets +2 to a skill test she is performing; or take an additional action this turn; or ready one Spell asset you control. Limit twice per round.
[elder] +X, where X = current Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test, reduce Dissonance by the amount this token added.
sthr-seraphine.flavor: "I reached for the Hour. Perhaps it reached back."
sthr-seraphine.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Seeker cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Bell of Ambergrove, "I Remember the Ending", The Debt of Hours.
sthr-seraphine.back_flavor: A spiritualist who felt the Occultation coming and reached for it — and may be the reason the door is stuck open.

sthr-bell.text: [action], exhaust, spend 1 charge, raise Dissonance by 1: Advance or rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.
sthr-bell.flavor: The bell marks the Hour. It can also un-mark it.

sthr-rememberending.text: Limit once per loop. Test [wil] (X = current Dissonance). If you succeed: look at the top 3 cards of the Occultation deck and put them back in any order; the next time the Hourglass would advance this round, cancel that advance.
sthr-rememberending.flavor: You have seen how this night ends. Not this time.

sthr-debtofhours.text: Revelation — If Dissonance is in the Noticed band: advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage. If in the Glitch band: take 2 horror. If in the Calm band: raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-birdie.text:
After you fail a skill test by 2 or more, place 1 Memory on Birdie. Limit once per round.
[free] Once per scenario, remove 3 Memory from Birdie: change a skill test you just failed into a success.
[elder] +1. If you have already failed a skill test this round, this token is +3 instead.
sthr-birdie.flavor: "Nobody believes a stranger. Suits me fine."
sthr-birdie.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 cards of any class at level 0–1, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lucky Compass, "I Get Out", Nobody Believes Her.
sthr-birdie.back_flavor: A young drifter who slipped into Ambergrove the wrong night and shouldn't remember a thing — but she does.

sthr-compass.text:
[action] Exhaust: Move to a connecting location. This move does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
If there are 2 or more Memory on the Lucky Compass, the above action may instead move you to any revealed location you have a Knowledge fact about.
sthr-compass.flavor: The needle always points at the way out.

sthr-igetout.text: Fast. Limit once per loop. Play when Birdie would be defeated: instead, disengage from all enemies, move to a connecting location, then heal 1 damage and 1 horror and place 1 Memory on your Lucky Compass.

sthr-nobodybelieves.text: Revelation — Until the end of the round, card abilities controlled by other investigators cannot target Birdie or her cards, and other investigators cannot take actions that would resolve effects on Birdie or her cards. If Birdie is the only investigator at her location, take 1 horror.
sthr-nobodybelieves.flavor: You try to warn them; they look right through you.

sthr-foreknowledge.text: Commit. [wild]. Remove 1 Memory from a card you control: this card provides [wild][wild][wild] instead.

sthr-dejavu.text: Fast. Play after you resolve a card ability during your turn; raise Dissonance by 1: trigger that same ability again if able.

sthr-musclememory.text: Commit. If your campaign log shows you performed this test type during the previous loop, [wild][wild] and draw 1 card; otherwise [wild].

sthr-rehearsedescape.text: Once per loop. Raise Dissonance by 1: automatically evade one enemy engaged with you (no test).
sthr-rehearsedescape.flavor: You have done this exact evade before.

sthr-longwayround.text: Move up to 2 connecting locations. This move ignores attacks of opportunity and any Skip effects that would trigger from moving.

sthr-borrowedtime.text:
Uses (3 Memory).
[free] Exhaust, remove 1 Memory from Borrowed Time: gain 1 resource or get +1 to a skill test you are performing.
sthr-borrowedtime.flavor: The sand runs upward, if you hold it right.

sthr-thistimeforsure.text: Play after you fail a skill test; raise Dissonance by 1: retry that test once with a +2 bonus.

sthr-anchorpoint.text:
Permanent.
At the start of each loop, gain 1 Memory.
sthr-anchorpoint.flavor: One fixed thing you always remember.

sthr-cassandrasnotebook.text: [reaction] After you unlock a Knowledge fact: draw 2 cards. Limit once per loop.
sthr-cassandrasnotebook.flavor: The pages ahead are already filled.

sthr-hourlearnedname.text: Limit once per loop. Deal damage to the Appointed equal to the number of Knowledge facts you have about it, then rewind the Hourglass by 1.

sthr-appointed.text:
Prey — the investigator with the most Memory. The Appointed cannot be attacked, cannot be evaded, and cannot be defeated.
It occupies an Approach stage (Unseen → Sensed → Emerging → Arrived) and manifests at the location farthest from the investigators while Sensed or later.
[action] Hold Back: Test [wil] or [com] (4). If you succeed, push the Appointed back one Approach stage and rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.
While Sensed: it does not move or attack. Forced — At the end of the round, each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.
While Emerging: it gains Hunter. Forced — When it engages an investigator: that investigator takes 1 horror.
While Arrived: it gains Hunter. Forced — When it attacks: it deals 2 damage and 2 horror, then raise Dissonance by 1.
Forced — When the Appointed would be defeated or leave play by any effect: instead, it does not.
sthr-appointed.flavor: It is not late. It was never late. You are simply early, every time.

sthr-appointedwhisper.text:
Peril.
Revelation — It knows your name now. Take 1 horror. If the Appointed is Emerging or Arrived, take 2 horror instead and raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-crossing.text: Revelation — Advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage (to a minimum of Sensed). Then raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-crossing.flavor: A door stands free in the square. Its far side shows the same square, one hour later.

sthr-bellringer.text:
Retaliate.
Spawns in the Flooded Crypt when it opens.
Forced — When the Hourglass reaches Hour III while the Bell-Ringer is in play: it readies and attacks the nearest investigator.
sthr-bellringer.flavor: It pulls the rope. The toll answers.

sthr-wearssheriff.text:
Hunter.
Spawns at the Records Office when the deep objective is attempted.
While What Wears the Sheriff is in play, the Records Office gains shroud +1.
sthr-wearssheriff.flavor: It does not want you reading the ledger.

sthr-onewhorides.text:
Prey — the investigator with the most Memory on their cards.
Spawns at the Wheel. Cannot be damaged while ready (evade it first; it only comes apart mid-turn, between rotations).
sthr-onewhorides.flavor: Round and round. It has always been riding. It will always be riding.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.text:
The lamp must be lit here before the stair will hold your weight.
[action] Investigate. If you succeed, you may light the Lantern (flip this location's investigators to the revealed side).
sthr-loc-lanternroom.flavor: The light remembers a path the dark has forgotten.

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text:
Forced — When you enter the Keeper's Quarters: read the top card of the encounter deck.
Search here (2 clues) for the keeper's logbook.
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.flavor: Eight names in his own hand. The ninth is blank, and wet.

sthr-loc-square.text: The Square is always the loop's start location. Investigators begin here each loop.
sthr-loc-square.flavor: You wake with the taste of salt and the certainty you have done this before.

sthr-agenda-hour1.text:
The night is young and already wrong.
When Doom reaches 3: advance. Set the Hourglass to Hour II.

sthr-act-ninthdeath.text: Objective — Recover the keeper's logbook from the Keeper's Quarters (2 clues), then read the ninth death.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.flavor: You have died in this night more times than anyone.

sthr-scenario-lighthouse.text: Setup — Place The Lantern Room, The Winding Stair, and The Keeper's Quarters in a row. Investigators begin at The Square. Encounter deck: shared spine + the Lighthouse node set. Set the Appointed aside at Unseen.

sthr-story-firstdark.text: You wake at First Dark with the taste of salt and the certainty you have done this before. The others feel it too. No one in Ambergrove will believe you.

sthr-loc-windingstair.text: [action] Test [agility] (2) to climb. If you fail, take 1 damage.
sthr-loc-windingstair.flavor: The steps do not always number the same.
